headline: Binance Pauses Withdrawals Amid Massive Crypto Hack Suspected to Be Billions
summary: The world's largest crypto exchange is investigating a security incident, with reports suggesting billions in funds may have been drained from its hot wallets.
details: Binance has confirmed it is addressing a security incident after users reported funds being drained from exchange wallets. The company stated that user funds are "completely safe" and its security teams are urgently reviewing the situation.

As a precautionary measure, Binance has temporarily suspended withdrawals on multiple networks. This action follows reports of a potential security issue and comes after Binance founder Changpeng Zhao indicated the company was likely hacked.

While numbers are unconfirmed and the theft may be ongoing, crypto watchers estimate at least $2 billion has been drained from Binance's hot wallets. Some estimates suggest losses could exceed $5.7 billion, potentially making this one of the largest crypto breaches in history.
Financial tech giant Circle has frozen approximately $800 million in Tether, and Tether itself has frozen about $1.56 billion related to the Binance hack. The identity of the hackers remains unknown.
caption:
Binance halts withdrawals after a suspected massive crypto hack. Billions may be at risk.

Binance has confirmed it is addressing a security incident after users reported funds being drained from exchange wallets. The company stated that user funds are "completely safe" and its security teams are urgently reviewing the situation.

As a precautionary measure, Binance has temporarily suspended withdrawals on multiple networks. This action follows reports of a potential security issue and comes after Binance founder Changpeng Zhao indicated the company was likely hacked.

While numbers are unconfirmed and the theft may be ongoing, crypto watchers estimate at least $2 billion has been drained from Binance's hot wallets. Some estimates suggest losses could exceed $5.7 billion, potentially making this one of the largest crypto breaches in history.

Financial tech giant Circle has frozen approximately $800 million in Tether, and Tether itself has frozen about $1.56 billion related to the Binance hack. The identity of the hackers remains unknown.

headline_marked: Intel's Nova Lake [[first client chip on 18A-P node]] to debut at CES
headline: Intel's Nova Lake first client chip on 18A-P node to debut at CES
summary: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan confirmed that the upcoming Nova Lake desktop processors will be the first client product to utilize the company's enhanced 18A-P manufacturing process. More details are expected at CES in January.
details: Intel's next-generation Nova Lake desktop processors are slated to be the first client products to feature the company's advanced 18A-P manufacturing node. CEO Lip-Bu Tan announced this during Intel's Q3 2026 earnings call, also revealing that further information will be shared at CES in January.

The 18A-P node offers significant improvements over the standard 18A process, boasting a 9% speed increase at equivalent power or an 18% power reduction at equivalent speeds. Intel has described 18A-P as a direct replacement for 18A, allowing existing designs to transition seamlessly without additional engineering.

Design wins for Nova Lake are reportedly expected to be double those of its predecessor, Panther Lake. This indicates strong anticipated adoption for the new processors, which are set to leverage Intel's most advanced manufacturing technology for client devices.

In a strategic shift, Intel is also reallocating some manufacturing capacity. The company plans to take Panther Lake production offline to prioritize the manufacturing of Granite Rapids data center CPUs, highlighting a focus on the high-demand server market.

Despite a projected decline in the overall PC market, with Intel anticipating a 12% drop in total addressable market units for 2026 and a further 10% in 2027, the company remains optimistic about gaining market share. This optimism is tempered by the ongoing memory shortage impacting pricing and availability.
